content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for LEDA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://powerlak.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the LEDA recruitment is 20th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the LEDA posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Energy Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent) or Architecture from a recognized University to be eligible for these posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this LEDA recruitment is 45 years. There is no mention of minimum age limit or age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in the LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Lakshadweep Energy Development Agency (LEDA) for the posts of Senior Energy Consultant and Assistant Energy Consultant.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the LEDA posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 55,000/- to Rs. 65,000/- per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the LEDA recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, verification of eligibility criteria, shortlisting of eligible candidates, and a personal interview, which may be conducted in a virtual mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for LEDA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this LEDA recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Lakshadweep Energy Development Agency (LEDA), which is https://powerlak.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these LEDA positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Senior Energy Consultant and Assistant Energy Consultant are on a contractual basis.
